labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Acknowledgments: clicks in Setup, separated by |
labels.value: Under Access to Send Email, set Access level to All email.|Click Save.|Come back here and click Check Again.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Acknowledgments: what to change for email
labels.value: Let this org send email, so emailed thank yous can go out.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Acknowledgments: why email needs Setup
labels.value: Salesforce sends no thank you emails unless Deliverability is set to All email, and only Setup can change it.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Acknowledgments: clicks in Setup, separated by |
labels.value: Click Add.|Enter the display name and the address, choose who may use it, then click Save.|Open the email Salesforce sends to that address and click its verification link.|Back here, choose the address in Acknowledgments from address.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Acknowledgments: what to change for From address
labels.value: To send thank yous from a shared address such as giving@yourorg.org, add and verify it as an organization-wide address.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Acknowledgments: why From address needs Setup
labels.value: Salesforce sends from a shared address only once Setup has added and verified it; without one, thank yous come from whoever sends them.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Receipts: clicks in Setup, separated by |
labels.value: Click Edit next to Gift Record Page.|Click Activation, then Assign as Org Default, and save.|Do the same for Giving Contact Record Page and Giving Account Record Page, choosing App Default and the BarnCRM app.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Receipts: what to change for record pages
labels.value: Assign Gift Record Page as the org default for Gift, so every gift shows the Receipts, Soft credits and Tribute panels. To show giving in the BarnCRM app, also assign Giving Contact Record Page and Giving Account Record Page to that app.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Receipts: why record pages need Setup
labels.value: Only Setup can assign a record page as a default, for the org or for an app.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Acknowledgments: clicks in Setup, separated by |
labels.value: In the Folder list, choose BarnCRM Acknowledgments.|Click BarnCRM: thank you for your gift, then Edit, or click New Template to write your own.|Change the wording, then click Save.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Acknowledgments: what to change for templates
labels.value: Write or change what an emailed thank you says in an email template. BarnCRM ships one to start from: BarnCRM: thank you for your gift.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Acknowledgments: why templates need Setup
labels.value: Salesforce keeps template editing, preview and test sends in its own editor, for everybody.
